title: Article
description: Single article. Claude's scheduled task writes one of these per story per day to data/articles/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<slug>.json. The build script renders each into web/posts/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<slug>.html.

slug.description: URL-safe slug, lowercase, hyphens. Becomes the filename and URL.

title.description: H1 title, <= 65 characters when possible. Includes the primary keyword.

tldr.description: 2-3 sentence summary at the top of the article.

body_markdown.description: Full article body in Markdown. Use H2 and H3 headings. Do NOT include the H1 (the title field is the H1).

thumbnail.description: Gradient colors for the card thumbnail.

importance_score.description: Highest-scored article becomes the featured story of the day.

og_image.description: Optional OG image URL. Defaults to /assets/img/og-default.svg.
